def scrape_songs_data(artist):
    songs_data = []

    search_url = f'https://www.google.com/search?q={artist} songs'
    headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_10_1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/39.0.2171.95 Safari/537.36'}
    response = requests.get(search_url, headers=headers)
    if response.status_code == 200:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, 'html.parser')
        results = soup.find_all('div', class_='g')
        pattern = re.compile(rf'^(.*?) - {artist}$', re.I)

        for result in results:
            song = result.find('h3')
            if song:
                name = song.get_text()
                if pattern.match(name):
                    songs_data.append(name)

    return songs_data

artist = input('Enter artist name: ')
songs_data = scrape_songs_data(artist)

with open(f'{artist} songs.csv', 'w') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    for song in songs_data:
        writer.writerow([song])
